key_highlights: ASX finishes the week higher despite late dips and macro uncertainty
Department store icon David Jones on the brink of collapse, triggering severe retail and REIT sector concerns
Qantas flags a $1 billion surge in fuel costs, prompting airfare increases and flight cuts amid Middle East tensions
Gold exploration and equity raisings accelerate across junior and mid-tier miners
Housing market pressures mount as reduced borrowing capacity and stagnant economic growth weigh on credit demand

sectors.trend: Severe solvency crisis in department store retail exemplified by the collapse of David Jones and unpaid suppliers.
sectors.implications: Heightened default risks across retail supply chains and elevated vacancy threats for major shopping centre landlords.

sectors.trend: Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz driving oil price volatility and acute fuel cost pressures.
sectors.implications: Substantial margin compression for airlines like QAN.AX forcing capacity cuts, while providing short-term revenue tailwinds for upstream energy producers.

sectors.trend: Strong equity capital market appetite for gold explorers alongside active junior exploration in lithium and base metals.
sectors.implications: Robust support for gold producers and selective junior resource runners (BPM.AX, CHN.AX) hedging broader macroeconomic stagflation.

sectors.trend: Borrowing capacity contraction driving house price declines while department store woes threaten anchor tenancies.
sectors.implications: Slowing mortgage book growth and potential provisioning upticks for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX), coupled with asset revaluation headwinds for retail REITs (VCX.AX, SCG.AX).

sectors.trend: Strong share performance in select digital infrastructure runners contrasting with rising community opposition to large-scale AI data centre builds.
sectors.implications: Potential approval delays and elevated development hurdles for data centre operators (NXT.AX), despite structural secular demand.

key_themes: Discretionary retail insolvency and tenant default contagion
Aviation margin squeeze under geopolitical fuel cost shocks
Capital rotation into gold and hard assets amidst sluggish domestic GDP growth
Credit contraction and residential property correction risks

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs with heavy department store exposure; prioritize non-discretionary essential retail assets.
Trim cyclical transport exposures like QAN.AX and hedge via overweight allocations to domestic energy majors.
Reduce exposure to retail mortgage-dependent banking stocks; rotate into quality defensive healthcare and cash equivalents.
Focus on high-yield, defensive consumer staples and offshore revenue generators less sensitive to Australian domestic demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Producers and Resource Explorers
opportunities.rationale: High broker appetite, active equity raises, and strong bullion pricing provide defensive earnings and inflation hedging.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Allocation to Upstream Oil & Gas
opportunities.rationale: Strait of Hormuz disruptions and rising jet fuel costs create favorable pricing dynamics for upstream producers.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Aviation and Discretionary Retail REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Qantas facing a $1B fuel surge and David Jones facing liquidation threaten airline margins and shopping mall rental streams.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shift into Consumer Staples and Defensive Healthcare
defensive_moves.rationale: Australian economic stagnation and constrained borrowing capacity require resilience against weakening household discretionary spending.

market_outlook.short_term: Rangebound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading between 8,100 and 8,350 as energy and mining gains are counterbalanced by consumer discretionary weakness and banking sector caution.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued earnings growth across domestic cyclicals until RBA monetary policy easing materializes and housing market pressures stabilize.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and updated monetary policy statement
Middle East geopolitical developments and crude oil/jet fuel price volatility
David Jones administration proceedings and retail tenant fallout
Australian quarterly GDP and household spending data
watch_list: Brent crude and Singapore jet fuel crack spreads
Iron ore spot pricing (62% Fe CFR China)
Australian residential auction clearance rates and mortgage arrears
